entries.description: Documented aether host watch --no-dashboard cannot reach the TS host because the watch subcommand disables Cobra flag parsing but calls makeHostSubcommand with forwardRawArgs=false. The raw --no-dashboard argument is therefore dropped before host.ts can set dashboard=false.
entries.suggestion: Forward raw args for host watch or remove the documented aether host watch --no-dashboard contract; add a Go forwarding regression test for watch.

entries.description: TS host parseArgs only accepts split value flags such as --depth balanced and --verification-depth heavy. Common --flag=value forms are treated as positional extras and silently omitted from the Go plan-only or continue plan-only invocation.
entries.suggestion: Support --flag=value for value flags or fail fast on unknown flag-like positional values; add parseArgs tests for equals-form and missing-value flags.
